answer: To stop one person running many fake agents, require civil registry in-person enrollment: each identity must appear once in person with fingerprint and photo verified by a registry officer. A fake costs one 20-credit enrollment fee plus one scarce appointment slot, and the fee doubles for each extra identity from the same funding source, so a farm of ten costs far more than ten honest users. This willow trellis vertex check keeps admission tied to a real person, not just a new key.
